data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (former Chief AI Officer at Absci and Meta researcher) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe). The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private biotech companies at similar or adjacent stages, including Colossal Biosciences, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $3.8B, implying $6.5B. Peer-median anchoring across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields $3.1B, with peer valuations ranging from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences, Series C). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not disclosed, which is typical for private companies; the sector median P/S multiple across three public biotech firms is 6.6x but is not actionable here.

Triangulating the two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $2.6B (low) to $7.4B (high), with a median of $4.8B. This range sits above the current post-money valuation of $3.8B, consistent with Stage C progression expectations. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and clinical/technical inflection points, neither of which are quantified in available data.
